add.k: A giant alien hunter in Sarge's crew
st: In season 6, Jaco hunts Shrikes with Sarge until S.H.I.E.L.D. captures him, then turns on Sarge and dies blowing up Izel's ship.

files.notes: On screen 601-604 and 607-609 (605 photo only). Group uses the app's existing 'Sarge's Crew' (Sarge's own file); he leaves it when he turns on Sarge in Collision Course Part Two (ep 119) and fights beside S.H.I.E.L.D. as an ally, not a member, so Independent from then.

add.k: A memory-wiped former agent living as a painter
st: In season 2, Janice Robbins, a T.A.H.I.T.I. patient given a new life as a painter, is murdered by Sebastian Derik over the alien writing.

files.notes: Only in The Writing on the Wall (29). Her real identity (the wiki's Rebecca Stevens, a Level 6 agent) appears in Coulson's memories of T.A.H.I.T.I.; Both names are said in the same episode ('Janice Robbins... she's an art teacher from Iowa'; later 'Agent Rebecca Stevens, level 6'); n stays Janice Robbins, the name she lives and dies under. S.H.I.E.L.D. stage is her service before the memory wipe; from ep 29 she has no named group (she teaches community art classes), so Independent.

st: In season 1, newlywed Jimmy Mackenzie falls under Lorelei's spell and drives her across the desert until she casts him aside and kills him.

files.notes: Tag scene of T.A.H.I.T.I. (14) and opening of Yes Men (15). He calls his wife 'Mrs. Mackenzie' on screen (wiki quote), so the surname is said; 'Jimmy!' is also said in T.A.H.I.T.I. (14). Yes Men's wiki plot says Lorelei kills him by slamming him into a car; status Deceased per wiki. Civilian: no group, Independent.

st: In season 3, John hides Lincoln, then calls the hotline on him and dies of a heart attack when Lincoln's jolt knocks his bat away.

files.notes: Only in A Wanted (Inhu)man (47). Only 'John' is said on screen (Lincoln: 'John, I don't know what to say'); the surname Donnelly is from the credits, so n is John. No named group, Independent.

k: Mack's father, held prisoner in the Lighthouse
A Chronicom Hunter wearing Mack's father's face
st: In season 7, posing as Mack's captive father, he lets Mack rescue him from the Lighthouse, then attacks on the Quinjet and Yo-Yo kills him.

files.notes: Seen in Luke's photos and surveillance footage in A Trout in the Milk (128); rescued, exposed and killed in Adapt or Die (129). Chronicom identity kept secret until ep 129 (reveal at its end). 'John' is first said in Adapt or Die (129: 'My name is John'; Mack: 'John, you mind if I take a look at your arm?'); in 128 he is only one of Mack's 'parents', so n is staged. The real John Mackenzie is not in the app.

add.k: A Belgian official secretly loyal to HYDRA
st: In season 2, Beckers debates Senator Ward on TV, then leads Agent Walters into Scarlotti's ambush and is caught at the border.

files.notes: Only in A Fractured House (28). Named on screen ('Mr. Beckers', Talbot: 'We got Beckers at the border'). Talbot's people catch him; Coulson's agent Walters (not in the app) is the one he betrays.

add.k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. pilot who defects to HYDRA
st: In season 1, pilot Kaminsky joins Garrett's HYDRA, helps raid the Fridge, and fights May with the Berserker staff until the base falls on him.

files.notes: Providence (18), Ragtag (21), Beginning of the End (22). Garrett names him on screen. Buried when May brings down the Barbershop; the wiki lists his status as Unknown, so Missing.

add.k: An Index-listed killer with razor fingernails
st: In season 2, Karla joins Zabo's revenge crew, frees David Angar, and takes command of the Slicing Talons until Bobbi defeats her.

files.notes: Only in One of Us (35). Bobbi calls her 'Karla' on screen; full name assumed shown on her Index file. Zabo names the team the Slicing Talons on screen.

add.k: An employee at Deke Shaw's tech company
st: In season 6, Kaya pitches new gadgets to her boss Deke, then shows off the ShawDrive he straps on to teleport away.

files.notes: Code Yellow (114) and The Sign (122). Named on screen ('Kaya, hold off on the pellets' in 114).

k: A HYDRA scientist in the Framework
st: In season 2, Turgeon leans on Simmons in the HYDRA lab, then is framed as the mole and dragged off by Bakshi's men.
In season 4, inside the Framework, Turgeon makes a strength serum for HYDRA and hands it to May to use against the Patriot.

files.notes: Making Friends and Influencing People (25), A Hen in the Wolf House (27); his Framework version in No Regrets (84), from the wiki page Kenneth Turgeon/Framework. The torture-table scene is a deleted scene (wiki ref AoS205DS), so the on-screen step ends with him dragged away. Named on screen ('Mr. Turgeon, hello!' and 'Kenneth's file' in 25).

add.k: A soldier in Nathaniel Malick's crew
st: In season 7, Kimball signals the Chronicom fleet for Malick and carries the captive Kora to him, then dies when Daisy quakes the fleet apart.

files.notes: Brand New Day (134), The End Is at Hand (135), What We're Fighting For (136). Malick first names her in The End Is at Hand (135: 'Kimball, you interested in a promotion?'), so n is staged. Nathaniel Malick and Kora are not in network_people, so no ties to them.

add.k: A coerced Cybertek handler running Centipede soldiers
st: In season 1, Zeller runs Cybertek's soldier handlers for Garrett until Skye straps a fake bomb to him and frees his kidnapped wife.

files.notes: On screen only in Beginning of the End (22); in Ragtag he is only spoken to on a call. 'Zeller' is said on screen; His wife says 'Kyle?' in 22. Forced service counts for Cybertek. Fate after the battle not shown (wiki: Alive), so At large.

st: In season 7, Li tests Yo-Yo with a Diviner and attacks May, then Malick captures him, drains his power and has Kora kill him.

files.notes: After, Before (131) and Stolen (133). Hostile to May and Yo-Yo at first but an Afterlife defender and Malick's victim, so a Compound file. Named on screen ('I can handle things from here, Li' in 131; 'Mr. Li' in 133).

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Jaco shoots down May's Quinjet when he arrives on Earth, then brawls with her inside Sarge's truck during the jewelry store robbery. May knocks him down twice before Sarge appears. Later she is on the truck when he says goodbye.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who beats him in a fight
stages.whoB: A giant alien she fights in Sarge's truck

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Yo-Yo questions Jaco in the Lighthouse, where he tells her about his lost family, and later knocks him back into the containment module on the Zephyr. After Sarge kills Pax, she talks Jaco into turning on Sarge, and he fights beside her on Izel's ship.
stages.whoA: The agent who talks him into turning on Sarge
stages.whoB: A captured alien she turns against Sarge

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Jaco chases Mack and Deke through Deke's office building, firing his rifle at them. Later he helps Sarge hijack the Zephyr and holds Mack at gunpoint. After switching sides, he joins Mack's team on Izel's ship and gets them home through a portal.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Director he holds at gunpoint
stages.whoB: A hijacker who later joins his mission

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: When Jaco breathes fire to melt his cell door in the Lighthouse, Daisy blasts the door into him and knocks him out with a shockwave.
stages.whoA: The agent who stops his fiery escape
stages.whoB: A captured alien who breathes fire

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sarge's crew picks Deke as a target, and Jaco knocks him down at his office, then hunts him with a rifle. Deke leads Jaco into his game room, where a video game traps his mind and S.H.I.E.L.D. takes him.
stages.whoA: A target who traps him in a video game
stages.whoB: A giant alien sent to kill him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Janice meets Derik at a bar, feels she knows him and invites him home. When she sees the alien writing tattooed on him, he attacks her and carves it into her, killing her.
stages.whoA: The man who murders her
stages.whoB: A fellow T.A.H.I.T.I. patient he murders

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: In Coulson's memories, he checks on her as a T.A.H.I.T.I. patient and has her memories replaced with a new life as Janice Robbins. After her murder, he studies her paintings to understand the writing.
stages.whoA: The agent who ran her treatment
stages.whoB: A T.A.H.I.T.I. patient he gave a new life

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Lorelei enthralls newlywed Jimmy at a desert motel, and he leaves his wife behind to drive her away. At a biker bar she finds new followers, frees him from her spell and kills him.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian who enthralls and kills him
stages.whoB: A newlywed she enthralls, then kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Lincoln calls his old friend John, who once talked him off a ledge, and John takes him in and sells him his car. After the news calls Lincoln a killer, John calls the hotline and holds him off with a bat. Lincoln's jolt stops his heart, and he dies despite Lincoln's efforts.
stages.whoA: His old friend, on the run
stages.whoB: The friend who once saved his life

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mack frees the man he believes is his father from the Lighthouse and flies him to safety on the Quinjet. When May senses he is a Chronicom, he attacks Mack and boasts that he took his parents' skins.
stages.whoA: The son of the man whose face he wears
stages.whoB: A Chronicom posing as his father

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Yo-Yo helps Mack rescue the man she thinks is his father from the Lighthouse. When the Chronicom attacks Mack on the Quinjet, she breaks his neck.
stages.whoA: The agent who breaks his neck
stages.whoB: A Chronicom posing as Mack's father

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: May helps the rescue and flies the Quinjet out of the Lighthouse. When he thanks her and touches her shoulder, she senses no emotion and warns Mack, and after the fight she opens the hatch to throw out his body.
stages.whoA: The agent who senses what he is
stages.whoB: A Chronicom she exposes by touch

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Beckers debates Senator Ward on TV, saying his plan to hunt S.H.I.E.L.D. agents destroys citizens' rights. Ward tells him Belgium is welcome to take S.H.I.E.L.D. in if it wants.
stages.whoA: A U.S. senator he debates on TV
stages.whoB: A Belgian official he debates on TV

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Kaminsky greets Garrett with a HYDRA salute at the Barbershop, then fires on him from a helicopter to fool the guards at the Fridge. He helps carry the failing Garrett to a table, and Garrett leaves him to guard the Barbershop.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA commander
stages.whoB: A pilot who joins his HYDRA team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Kaminsky's helicopter fires on Ward and Garrett so the Fridge guards will trust them, then he joins the raid. Later he helps Ward carry the failing Garrett to a table.
stages.whoA: A fellow HYDRA agent under Garrett
stages.whoB: A HYDRA pilot on Garrett's team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: When Coulson's team raids the Barbershop, Kaminsky waits for them with the Berserker staff. May takes the staff from him and uses it to bring the base down on him.
stages.whoA: The agent who takes his staff
stages.whoB: A HYDRA pilot she buries in rubble

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Zabo recruits Karla into his revenge crew and frees her hands from S.H.I.E.L.D.'s shackles. She doubts the plan, but his story about his lost daughter wins her over. When he vanishes at the school, she takes command.
stages.whoA: The man who recruits her for revenge
stages.whoB: A razor-fingered recruit for his crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Bobbi goes over Karla's file with Coulson, then hides beneath the bleachers at the school. When Karla leads the attack, Bobbi fights her staves against nails and knocks her into a wall.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats her at the school
stages.whoB: A killer with razor fingernails

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson studies Karla's Index file as Zabo's crew gathers. At the school she holds unconscious students in the bleachers to draw him out, and his team arrests her.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Director she wants to punish
stages.whoB: An Index killer in Zabo's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Kaya brings her boss Deke new products to try and passes on Engineering's praise for his ideas. Later, at the Lighthouse, she presents the ShawDrive, and Deke straps it on and teleports away.
stages.whoA: Her boss, the founder of the company
stages.whoB: An employee at his tech company

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Turgeon supervises Simmons in the HYDRA lab and lets her coach him for a report to his superiors. Weeks later they share a project, and he is blamed as the mole she really is.
stages.whoA: The undercover agent he supervises
stages.whoB: Her supervisor in the HYDRA lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Bakshi sends Turgeon and Simmons to Whitehall's meeting. When evidence turns up at Turgeon's desk, Bakshi's men knock him out and drag him away.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA officer who drags him off
stages.whoB: A lab supervisor accused of spying

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Bobbi, working HYDRA security, announces a mole in the lab, and the search finds evidence at Turgeon's desk. He tells her it is not his before he is dragged away.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA security chief who accuses him
stages.whoB: A lab supervisor caught in her search

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: In the Framework, May comes to Turgeon's HYDRA lab for his new serum. He explains what is in it and promises one dose will leave the Patriot begging for his life.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA agent who takes his serum
stages.whoB: A HYDRA scientist with a serum

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Garrett teleports Malick's crew, this soldier among them, onto the stolen Zephyr, and they fly into space together to meet the Chronicom fleet.
stages.whoA: A teleporting member of Malick's crew
stages.whoB: A soldier in Malick's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Kimball watches as Kora reaches Daisy on the Chronicom ship and ruins Malick's plan. When the fight spreads through the fleet, Daisy quakes it apart, killing Kimball.
stages.whoA: The agent who destroys the fleet
stages.whoB: A soldier in Malick's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Zeller runs the soldier handlers at Cybertek for Garrett and reports when May brings the Barbershop down. Skye then uses Zeller's phone to warn Garrett that Coulson is coming.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA boss
stages.whoB: His handler at Cybertek

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Skye storms the handlers' room with a bomb, straps it to Zeller and guesses he is a pawn of the Incentives Program. She drags him to the dormitories, frees his wife, and shows him the bomb is a toy.
stages.whoA: The agent who frees his wife
stages.whoB: A coerced handler she bluffs

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: May and Skye bluff their way into the handlers' room at Cybertek. May holds off Ward while Skye takes Zeller to free his wife.
stages.whoA: An agent who storms his control room
stages.whoB: A Cybertek handler she helps capture

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Li serves as Jiaying's second-in-command, pressing her to kill Kora and warning that May and Yo-Yo cannot be allowed to leave Afterlife. When Malick attacks, Jiaying escapes while Li is captured.
stages.whoA: The Afterlife leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her second-in-command at Afterlife

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Li distrusts May at Afterlife, tells her he decides when she leaves and attacks her with a knife he creates. Later both fight off Malick's men when they attack Afterlife.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he attacks
stages.whoB: Jiaying's suspicious second-in-command

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Li doubts Yo-Yo's story and makes her touch a Diviner to prove she is Inhuman. He attacks May hoping to force Yo-Yo to use her powers, but she cannot.
stages.whoA: An agent he tests with a Diviner
stages.whoB: The Inhuman who tests her with a Diviner

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Li and Gordon chase Kora through the woods and find May and Yo-Yo, and Li orders Gordon to teleport them to Afterlife.
stages.whoA: A fellow Afterlife Inhuman
stages.whoB: Jiaying's second-in-command
